# YouTube Plus v{VERSION}

## 🎉 What's New

YouTube Plus (formerly YTLite) is a flexible enhancer for YouTube on iOS, featuring over a hundred customizable options.

### ✨ Key Features

- **Download Everything**: Videos, audio with track selection, thumbnails, posts, and profile pictures
- **Information Tools**: Copy video, comment, and post information
- **Interface Customization**: Remove feed elements, reorder tabs, OLED mode, Shorts-only mode
- **Advanced Player**: Gesture controls, default quality, preferred audio tracks
- **Settings Management**: Save, load, restore settings; automatic cache clearing
- **Built-in SponsorBlock**: Automatically skip sponsored segments
- **100+ Options**: Extensive customization possibilities

### 🔧 Available Integrations

This build supports the following optional tweaks:
- **YouPiP** - Native Picture-in-Picture support
- **YTUHD** - Unlock 1440p/2160p quality
- **Return YouTube Dislikes** - See dislike counts
- **YouQuality** - Quick quality selector overlay
- **DontEatMyContent** - Prevent notch from cropping videos

> **Note**: Select which integrations you want when building via GitHub Actions

## 📱 Compatibility

- **YouTube Version**: {YT_VERSION} (Tested)
- **iOS**: All versions supported by YouTube

## 📦 What's Included

This IPA includes:
- YouTube Plus v{VERSION}
- Open in YouTube (Safari extension)
- [Optional tweaks based on build configuration]

## 🚀 Installation

### For Jailbroken Devices
1. Install via your package manager
2. YouTube Plus preferences will appear in YouTube Settings

### For Sideloading (Non-Jailbroken)
1. Download the IPA from this release
2. Use AltStore, SideStore, or similar tools to sideload
3. Trust the certificate in Settings > General > VPN & Device Management
4. Open YouTube and enjoy!

## 🔍 How to Find Preferences

After installation:
1. Open YouTube app
2. Go to Settings (your profile picture)
3. Look for **YouTube Plus** section
4. Explore and customize over 100 options!

## 🛠️ Build Your Own

Want to build with custom settings?

1. Fork this repository
2. Go to Actions > "Create YouTube Plus app"
3. Click "Run workflow"
4. Provide decrypted YouTube IPA URL
5. Select desired integrations
6. Customize Bundle ID and Display Name
7. Download from your fork's releases

**Detailed instructions**: [README.md](https://github.com/nonokh/YTLite#how-to-build-a-youtube-plus-app-using-github-actions)

## ⚠️ Important Notes

- This is a modified version of YouTube. Use at your own risk.
- A decrypted YouTube IPA is required for building (we cannot provide this for legal reasons)
- Respect YouTube's Terms of Service
- Report issues on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nonokh/YTLite/issues)
